newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IFS ups stake in Indonesian firm.
newsitem.headline: IFS ups stake in Indonesian firm.

text.p: Singapore financial services group International Factors Singapore Ltd (IFS) said on Tuesday it had increased its equity stake in Indonesia's Niaga Factoring Corporation (NFC) from 40 to 47 percent.

IFS said in a statement it had raised its holding by buying all 18,040 NFC shares held by PT Usaha Sarana Sejati (USS) and by subscribing for another 2,820 shares. PT Bank Niaga holds the remaining 53 percent stake in NFC. The IFS statement said the company's investment in NFC would not have a significant impact on the net tangible assets and net earnings per share of the IFS group for the year ended December 31 1996.
